commit_message:
Merge commit from fork
Make SourceRepositoryRef check case-sensitive
task_text:
The verification step that checks the source repository ref on an attestation's signing certificate currently compares it case-insensitively, so a ref that differs from the expected one only in letter case is accepted. This is incorrect because Git refs are case-sensitive. A branch name with different capitalization is a different branch and should not satisfy the policy.

The comparison must be an exact, case-sensitive match. When the certificate's ref differs from the expected ref in letter case, verification must fail. The error must state both the expected value and the value actually found. Exact matches must continue to pass, and mismatches in other certificate fields must behave as they do now.
